name: Scrapdeck / Refurb Cyberdeck / salvaged intrusion terminal

description.value:
Deck value = Bandwidth capacity + edges + program slots. Item Tier never gates WHETHER you can try a node - only how well-supplied you are.

  • Item Tier: T5
  • Availability: 5
  • Cost: ¥300
  • Profile: Bottom-rung deck. Runs a persona and a single program; bane on holding more than one compromised node at once (thin buffer). The deck you start with or ditch.
  • Mod slots: 1
  • Tags: Wired

Item Tier sets price, Availability, and mod-slot count only — never raw power.
